title: Limitations of ROC on Imbalanced Data: Evaluation of LVAD Mortality Risk Scores
reasoning: The paper includes a significant section titled 'Clinical Perspectives' that is dedicated to the moral and ethical trade-offs inherent in using the evaluated medical classifiers. It discusses the conscious clinical decision between risking a 'False SURV' (misplaced faith in the classifier leading to a potentially harmful procedure) versus a 'False DEAD' (denying a patient a potentially life-saving procedure). This analysis of the ethical implications of model errors in a life-or-death context forms a core part of the paper's discussion.
